en.s4p5Start: Let's begin with a circle and its centre.

en.s4p5Left: The region left is the minor segment.

en.s4p7Ask: θ = 90°, so what is the area of the triangle?
en.s4p7Right: The two radii form the base and height, so the area is {f}.
en.s4p7WrongHalfR: {f} uses only one length. A triangle's area is ½ × base × height.
en.s4p7WrongRR: {f} gives the area of the whole square. The triangle is half of it.

en.s4p8AskTriangle: Choose the area of the triangle.
en.s4p8AskSegment: Choose the area of the segment.
en.s4p8Find: Let’s find the area of the minor segment.

en.s4p8Wrong616: 616 cm² is the area of the whole circle. The sector is only one-quarter of it.
en.s4p8Wrong77: 77 cm² is one-eighth of the circle. A 90° sector is one-quarter.

en.s4p10Ask: Find the area of the segment.
en.s4p10Found: So, the area of the segment is 56 cm².
en.s4p10Wrong58: 154 − 98 is 56, not 58. Try the subtraction again.
en.s4p11Big: Now, let's look at the larger piece: the major segment.
en.s4p11How: Let’s see how to find its area.
en.s4p11Tri: Here is the triangle with central angle θ.
en.s4p11Back: Add the triangle to the major sector.
en.s4p11Together: Together, they form the major segment.
en.s4p13AskSector: Choose the area of the major sector.
en.s4p13AskSegment: Choose the area of the major segment.
en.s4p13Find: Let’s find the area of the major segment.
en.s4p13Found: So, the area of the major segment is 560 cm².
en.s4p13Check: Check: 56 + 560 = 616 = πr². Together, the two segments form the whole circle.
en.s4p13Wrong154: 154 cm² is the minor sector, one-quarter of the circle. The major sector is the remaining three-quarters.
en.s4p13Wrong616: 616 cm² is the whole circle. The major sector covers 270° out of 360°.
en.s4p13Wrong364: 364 cm² is 462 − 98. For the major segment, add the triangle instead of subtracting it.
en.s4p13Wrong462: 462 cm² is only the major sector. The triangle still needs to be added.

en.s4p14Wrong14: 14 cm² is the minor segment. The major segment is the rest of the circle.
en.s4p14Wrong154: 154 cm² is the whole circle. Subtract the minor segment from it.

en.s4p15Wrong156: 156 cm² is greater than the sector area of 154 cm². The water is the sector minus the triangle.
en.s4p15Wrong256: 256 cm² is also greater than the sector area. The water occupies only part of the sector.
